blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: You're getting famous for dancing on TikTok?
exercises.why: **танцевать → танцуя** — gerund (деепричастие) of an imperfective verb: present stem + -я; the action goes on at the same time as the main verb.

exercises.prompt: He ran away with his tail between his legs.
exercises.why: **поджать → поджав** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.prompt: I acted without thinking.
exercises.why: **раздумывать → раздумывая** — gerund (деепричастие) of an imperfective verb: present stem + -я; the action goes on at the same time as the main verb.

exercises.q: На санях, ___ (укутаться) лохматым тулупом, сидел рыжеусый мужчина.
exercises.prompt: Sitting on the sleigh, wrapped in a shaggy sheepskin coat, was a red-haired man.
exercises.why: **укутаться → укутавшись** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -вшись; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.why: **жить → Живя** — gerund (деепричастие) of an imperfective verb: present stem + -я; the action goes on at the same time as the main verb.

exercises.q: Этот мальчик проводил время, ___ (швырять) камни в озеро.
exercises.prompt: The boy passed the time by flinging stones into the lake.

exercises.q: ___ (вдохновиться) азиатскими религиями, он создал прекрасные скульптуры.
